# Find Feed Restore

> Find Feed Restore (Find, Feed & Restore) is a Central Florida nonprofit, based in Clermont, FL, helping families with children and survivors of domestic violence move from homelessness to stability through housing, financial literacy, mental health counseling, and practical support.

This file provides a concise directory of the site's canonical public pages. Use the linked pages as the authoritative source for program details, legal terms, contact information, and current campaigns.

- Address: 20180 US Highway 27 Ste 308, Clermont, FL 34715
- Phone: (866) 236-2983
- Email: info@findfeedrestore.com
- Donate: https://findfeedrestore-bloom.kindful.com/
- Apply for housing assistance: https://app.planstreetinc.com/findfeedrestore/PublicForm

## Programs

- [Domestic Violence (Miriam’s Hope)](https://www.findfeedrestore.com/miriams-hope/): 6–12 months of no-cost transitional housing for survivors of domestic violence and their children, with trauma-informed and mental health counseling, case management, financial literacy, employment and credit support, childcare connections, and help preparing for permanent housing.
- [Affordable Housing](https://www.findfeedrestore.com/affordable-housing/): Permanent affordable housing (Hannah Grace Gardens) for working families with children.
- [Housing First](https://www.findfeedrestore.com/housing-first/): 6–12 months of rent- and utility-free housing and support that help homeless families with children regain stability.
- [Homelessness Avoidance](https://www.findfeedrestore.com/homelessness-avoidance/): Temporary financial assistance with rent, mortgage, and utilities, plus stability services, for households at risk of homelessness.
- [Care Coach Mobile Unit](https://www.findfeedrestore.com/care-coach-mobile-unit/): Mobile health, housing, meal, and support resources for underserved communities.

## Campaigns

- [Live Here Love Here Lake](https://www.findfeedrestore.com/live-here-love-here-lake/): Corporate partnership campaign for local businesses supporting housing for families.
- [We Need Trailers](https://www.findfeedrestore.com/we-need-trailers/): Donate a travel trailer, fifth wheel, or RV to house a family; includes the trailer donation inquiry form.
